parameters.command: cd /home/danijel-jd/Dokumente/Workspace/Projekte/Gesamtprojekt && docker-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d opena3 opena4 opena5 opena6 opena7 opena8 opena9 opena10 opena12 opena13 opena14 opena16 opena17 opena18 opena21

=python3 - <<'PY'
import base64, os
html_b64 = '''{{ $json.html_b64 }}'''
path = '''{{ $json.target_path }}'''
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
with open(path, 'wb') as f:
    f.write(base64.b64decode(html_b64))
print(f"✅ Saved: {path}")
PY

cd /home/danijel-jd/Dokumente/Workspace/Projekte/Gesamtprojekt/19.opena20_dashboard_agent && tar -czf /tmp/portier_dashboards_$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M%S).tar.gz data/dashboard_pages/*.html && ls -lh /tmp/portier_dashboards_*.tar.gz | tail -1 | awk '{print $NF}'

=ssh root@{{ $credentials.hetzner_server.host }} '
cd /opt/Gesamtprojekt/19.opena20_dashboard_agent && 
tar -xzf /tmp/portier_dashboards.tar.gz -C . && 
echo "✅ Extracted to opena20" && 
cd /opt/Gesamtprojekt && 
docker-compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml restart opena20 && 
echo "✅ opena20 restarted on Hetzner" && 
rm /tmp/portier_dashboards.tar.gz
'
